# Mara Vale

Mara is the player Character, an apprentice who knows the bell's mechanism
better than the keeper does. She tightens loose screws while talking, even
when the machinery is not hers. She wants Ivo's trust but resents having to
ask for it. Her previous repair preceded a wreck; responsibility remains an
open question, not an established verdict.
